title: Q-ROOT-unclassified: unclassified keeps recurring: Add a root-cause class (id, match, root, guard, remedy) to doctrine/rootcauses.json for these findings.
body:
**Owner:** operations
**Trigger:** the daily failure audit files it when a root cause recurs; the executor takes it in driver order
**Done check:** cmd:python3 -m foundation rootcause --probe unclassified
**Status:** closed

Root cause class `unclassified` recurred on 5 days (2026-11-21, 2026-11-22, 2026-11-23, 2026-11-24, 2026-11-25); the guard exists and the failure still returned: the guard is ineffective, so redesign it (a fourth attempt of the same fix is not allowed).
Root cause: no root-cause class explains this finding
Guard: `file:doctrine/rootcauses.json`
Remedy: Add a root-cause class (id, match, root, guard, remedy) to doctrine/rootcauses.json for these findings.
Symptoms seen:
- failure-audit:seed-autonomous: seed-autonomous a seed was deployed with a database and a cron only: no source-control credential and no repository of i
- failure-audit:sla-breach: sla-breach an item outlived its written SLA because no loop owned its state  argument cmd: invalid choice: 'slawatch' (c
Fix the root, not the symptom: the item closes when the guard passes and the class stays quiet for 2 days.

**Closing probe:** cmd:python3 -m foundation rootcause --probe unclassified

**Disposition:** shelved (ttl, 2026-11-25T16:12:21Z, DISPOSE-1)

**Evidence:** open 93.3 hours (limit 6 hours) and no loop closed it (SLA-8H-1). Its closing probe still runs on every fleet pass and records `fixed` when it passes; the executor retries it when its open queue is empty (every 30 days at most).
